stub_knowledge.title: Runbook: Node DiskPressure and pod evictions
stub_knowledge.chunk: When a node reports DiskPressure, the kubelet evicts pods to reclaim ephemeral storage. Check eviction events ('The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage'), container logs for 'no space left on device', and node disk usage (images, container logs, emptyDir volumes). Remediation candidates for a human: free disk space, tune image-gc thresholds, or add ephemeral-storage requests/limits so eviction is fair.

stub_knowledge.title: Runbook: ImageGCFailed
stub_knowledge.chunk: ImageGCFailed means the kubelet could not free enough disk by removing unused images — usually because most disk is consumed by container writable layers or logs, not images. Inspect the node's largest consumers before adding capacity.

useful_rubric_notes: Useful when the draft ties pod eviction to node DiskPressure and cites the eviction event plus the disk runbook.
